prompt: A member wants to make it to the club without joining the wrong queue. What should they do on Saturday?
promptZh: 一位成員要去參加活動，又不想排錯隊。本週六應該怎麼走？

options.text: Use the main desk and follow the weekday group’s notice.
options.zh: 去主服務台，照平日小組的公告走。
options.whyZh: 平日小組不同，週六也不該到主服務台排隊。

options.text: Wait on the square until someone calls them.
options.whyZh: 本週六改在會堂，沒有在廣場集合再通知的安排。

options.text: Use the courtyard entrance and join the queue at the main desk.
options.zh: 從中庭入口進去，再到主服務台排隊。
options.whyZh: 入口選對了，但應沿箭頭走，不是到主服務台排隊。

options.text: Follow the club’s arrows from the courtyard entrance.
options.zh: 從中庭入口沿解謎社的箭頭走。
options.whyZh: 講者指定週六循箭頭進場，以免排進主服務台的隊伍。

explanationZh: 講者指定週六循箭頭進場，以免排進主服務台的隊伍。
evidence: On Saturday, follow our arrows from the courtyard entrance instead of joining the queue at the main desk.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: On Saturday, follow our arrows from the courtyard entrance instead of joining the queue at the main desk.

vocabulary.note: 此處是依指示前往活動的入口。
